name: Classic Native
scope: 499 native city masters and 166 UI slots; 118 animations. Visual Enhancements use the shared project assets for SC2000 and RS.
generation: Buildings: individually referenced AI-generated designs, native palette and geometry corrections, then SC2K Author brightmaps. Other asset families retain their documented prior procedure.
references: Local original images inspected for dimensions, colors, function and proportional reference. No original image pixels are included in the replacement artwork.

license.generated_artwork: CC BY 4.0; Daniel Gimmer (Realm667); https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Applies to licensable rights in the replacement artwork and masks; see graphics/LICENSE-STATUS.txt. Public-domain elements remain unrestricted.
license.existing_project_code: Retain the OpenSC2K MIT notice for reused code and existing procedural effects; it does not establish a license for the newly generated artwork.

review: Consolidated current local source set including Daniel manual edits and all subsequent reviewed corrections through cinema-uplights-20261025. Authorized for local Runtime testing on 2026-10-25; no publication authorized by this consolidation.

building_production.review: Technical and visual production checks complete; final human approval remains open.

remaining_production.review: Technical checks complete; human aesthetic approval remains open.
